User Story: As a host integrator I need the kit to declare brand identity so ports never invent a mascot name.
Expected Behaviour: mark.json declares version versioned string; name 'Mininja mark'; owner 'Thingscorp LLC'; mascotNamed===false; forbiddenNames includes 'Casque'. Glyphs ARE the mark.
Edge Cases: Any truthy mascotNamed; missing Casque in forbiddenNames; inventing alternate personal names in host copy.
Notes: check-consumers enforces mascotNamed + Casque. Never name the mascot.

User Story: As a designer I need a fixed cell grid so every face stays on the same lockup metric.
Expected Behaviour: grid.columns=5 rows=3 cellAspect='1:1' totalCells=15. Canonical lines are exactly 5 cells × 3 rows.
Edge Cases: Non-square cells; lines with wrong cell count; redrawing mark as bitmap substitute.
Notes: Narrated by CONSTRUCTION.md / STYLEGUIDE; numbers only in mark.json.

User Story: As an adapter author I need the hood/block codepoints listed so renderers do not invent glyphs.
Expected Behaviour: codepoints lists hoodCornerRightFacing U+259A; hoodCornerLeftFacing U+259E; fullBlock U+2588; upperHalfBlock U+2580; space U+0020.
Edge Cases: Substituting similar box-drawing; omitting mirrored corner for left-facing.
Notes: Eyes/state glyphs live under faces not codepoints.

User Story: As a stranger porting Mininja I need a single idle lockup I can ship in ~60s.
Expected Behaviour: canonicalIdle.lines is the default three-line right-facing lockup; note states glyphs ARE the mark.
Edge Cases: Empty lines; diverging from faces.idle.lines; treating SVG as SoT.
Notes: Presence ladder level 1 mark-only needs canonicalIdle.

User Story: As a scoot host I need a left-facing body so loadingLeft and facing-left work without redrawing.
Expected Behaviour: mirroredIdle.lines is left-facing body; usedBy includes loadingLeft and facing-left. faces.loadingLeft.mirrored===true.
Edge Cases: Mirroring eyes only without body; using right hood on left face.
Notes: Presence ladder level 3 scoot-facing needs mirroredIdle.

User Story: As a brand reproducer I need clearspace and min size numbers from kit not brand prose inventing them.
Expected Behaviour: clearspace.rule one block-row height; asFractionOfHeight≈1/3. minimumSize.digitalPxHeight=24 terminalRows=3 minCellPx=8.
Edge Cases: Shrinking below 24px digital; ignoring terminal 3-row floor.
Notes: Docs narrate; kit holds numbers.

User Story: As a UI host I may tint chrome with mood colors but must keep the mark fill monochrome.
Expected Behaviour: monochrome===true. moodColorsUiOnly keys idle/accent/ok/warn/err with hex #334155 #6366f1 #22c55e #eab308 #ef4444. Face tones use those five ids.
Edge Cases: Painting mark fill from mood hex; inventing parallel mood table; treating muted as mark moodColorsUiOnly key.
Notes: STYLEGUIDE: muted is optional host/scene tone; scene emotions use muted. Recipe then.mood.tone should stay recipe-compatible with tone ids.

User Story: As a creature host I need the closed set of face ids with eyes/tone/motion/mirrored/lines.
Expected Behaviour: faces object has exactly 15 keys: idle blink evaluating allowed asking denied sandboxing executing completed warning error cancelled offline loadingRight loadingLeft. Each has eyes[2] tone motion mirrored lines[3].
Edge Cases: Unknown face id (adapters fall back to idle); firing blink as a response face; inventing parallel face tables in hosts.
Notes: Recipe then.face targets these ids. Demotion of recipes ≠ remove face vocabulary.

User Story: As a porter I need an explicit ladder so I can ship mark-only without dragging scene.
Expected Behaviour: presenceLadder levels 1 mark-only (canonicalIdle); 2 face-states (faces); 3 scoot-facing (faces+mirroredIdle); 4 scene-strip (kit/scene.json).
Edge Cases: Skipping to scene without documenting layer; claiming scene required for first face.
Notes: PORTING.md narrates; ladder data in mark.json.

User Story: As a habitat host I need exact strip math so camera/rest points do not drift.
Expected Behaviour: geometry.stageWidthPx=420 stageCount=7 worldWidthPx=2940 anchorRatio=0.42 restOffsetPx=176.4; formulas for stageOrigin restPoint worldWidth.
Edge Cases: Inserting 8th stage without updating N/L; using 0.5W rest; dual STAGE_WIDTH constant.
Notes: Console must align; check-consumers asserts. Apps UI not kit-owned.

User Story: As a runner I need stock defaults when no intent is applied.
Expected Behaviour: defaultScene emotion=idle action=idle stage=dock facing=right line='' intensity=1 holdMs=0.
Edge Cases: Teleporting unknown stage; empty emotion.
Notes: Matches TERMINAL-MOTION defaults.

User Story: As a locomotion host I need walk/run/patrol/camera/step numbers from kit.
Expected Behaviour: motion includes walkPxPerSec=170 runPxPerSec=280 patrolPxPerSec=26 arriveEpsilonPx=6 patrol insets/span camera look-aheads follow rate step periods dtClamp adjacentStageWalk/RunSec fullPatrolSec.
Edge Cases: Inlining divergent speeds in banner; ignoring reduced-motion host policy (host not kit).
Notes: check-consumers asserts console walk/run + camera ratios.

User Story: As a scenery host I need the closed weather set for stage atmosphere only.
Expected Behaviour: weather array: clear haze night sparks scan rain. Stage.weather must be one of these. Weather never recolors the mark; not external automation.
Edge Cases: Using rain as recipe weather-from-world; inventing fog; painting eyes from weather.
Notes: PASS vs SCENERY: rain documented as overlay-only. Recipes later plate ≠ scene weather.

User Story: As a décor author I need the closed propKind vocabulary including garden repoBranch.
Expected Behaviour: propKinds: block shelf lamp crate screen antenna moon barrier cable repoBranch. Stock stage props only use kinds in set.
Edge Cases: Inventing chair/desk kinds silently; placing repoBranch without growth schema awareness.
Notes: repoBranch intentional unused in stock stages (overlay).

User Story: As a habitat host I need the seven rooms nightwatch→rooftop with geometry props and weather.
Expected Behaviour: stages[7] ids nightwatch dock desk workshop archives gate rooftop; each has index id label hint x width center weather props[]. Geometry consistent with stageWidthPx.
Edge Cases: Renaming stage ids (breaks recipe/command maps); shifting x without updating worldWidth.
Notes: archives never in legacyFaceBridge — not an orphan; habitat vocabulary for look/pgeon. Recipe-compatible stage ids.

User Story: As a scene author I need emotion ids with tone/eyes/motion/hint for SceneIntent.emotion.
Expected Behaviour: emotions[16]: idle curious focused happy proud mischievous worried confused startled embarrassed frustrated determined relieved sleepy alert sad.
Edge Cases: Unknown emotion → fallbacks.unknownEmotion=curious; inventing parallel emotion tables.
Notes: Unbridged emotions alert/relieved/sad/startled are intentional habitat vocab (not orphans). muted tone used by some emotions.

User Story: As a scene author I need action ids with motion/pose/fx/hint for SceneIntent.action and presence data-motion.
Expected Behaviour: actions[22]: idle blink walk run think scan type read point wave jump crouch lookBack celebrate shakeHead nod search wait sleep carry peek climb.
Edge Cases: Unknown action → fallbacks.unknownAction=wait; inventing parallel motion expression unions in adapters.
Notes: Recipe-compatible: then.action and data-motion share action ids. Unbridged actions are habitat expansion.

Feature Name: Legacy face bridge (15 faces → scene intents)
User Story: As a host still emitting compact face ids I need a deterministic map into emotion/action/stage/facing.
Expected Behaviour: legacyFaceBridge keys === mark.faces keys (15). Values reference valid emotion/action and optional stage/facing. No orphan faces or bridge keys.
Edge Cases: Face id with missing emotion target; doc claiming dock stage for idle/blink while kit omits stage.
Notes: DEFECT-DOC-001 Fixed 2026-09-25: TERMINAL-MOTION idle/blink stage=— (keep-current); kit legacyFaceBridge omits stage. Prefer doc fix; kit untouched.

User Story: As a runner I need safe behavior for unknown ids without crashing the buddy UI.
Expected Behaviour: fallbacks.unknownEmotion=curious; unknownAction=wait; unknownStage='keep-current'.
Edge Cases: Teleporting to fake stage; crashing on unknown recipe face (runners warn only — design).
Notes: Aligned with TERMINAL-MOTION + RECIPES unknown-id guidance.

User Story: As a host overlaying repos-as-branches I need an integer growth scale with labels.
Expected Behaviour: garden.metaphor repos-as-growing-branches; propKind repoBranch; growth min=0 max=5 type=integer default=0; steps seed sprout sapling young branching canopy.
Edge Cases: Non-integer growth; values outside 0..5; dual growth tables beside kit.
Notes: Recipe then.growth design targets this field; growth ≠ weather ≠ mark fill.

User Story: As a renderer I need recommended h(g)=h0+g*dh for repoBranch silhouettes.
Expected Behaviour: silhouetteHeightPx formula h(g)=h0+g*dh; h0Px=12 dhPx=12 → h(3)=48. Hosts may fork; authored prop h wins.
Edge Cases: Using growth to paint mark fill; ignoring authored h.
Notes: scene.json 1.6.1 added this map.

User Story: As a kit consumer I need the prop field contract and certainty kit never calls GitHub.
Expected Behaviour: propFields.kind=repoBranch; required kind x y; optional w h growth label; growth omit→default. bridge.github=false.
Edge Cases: Embedding GitHub tokens in kit; treating kit as live stats source.
Notes: Live stats = host overlay when recipes plate lands.

User Story: As a future recipe runner I need face/action/stage/growth/mood ids to remain the shared brick vocabulary.
Expected Behaviour: Design-only in RECIPES.md. then may set face|action|stage|mood|growth. Face ids ⊂ mark.faces; stage/action ⊂ scene; growth 0..5 or {prop,value}. Not scene weather; not mark fill. v1 ships without recipe runner; demotion ≠ disconnection.
Edge Cases: Orphaning face ids; inventing parallel expression tables in adapters; treating recipes as v1 hero.
Notes: Kit owns seams (ids); Apps would own runner UI later. Hold kit JSON churn.

User Story: As a maintainer I need a fail-closed check that known consumers do not fork kit numbers.
Expected Behaviour: node kit/check-consumers.mjs reads mark+scene; asserts mascot invariants; when console/ present asserts STAGE_WIDTH anchorRatio walk/run camera ratios no STAGE_SEED dual tables import kit/scene.json + registerFromKit habitat APIs and every propKind string. Never invents values.
Edge Cases: Console absent → skip console asserts still OK; any mismatch → exit 1.
Notes: Recorded PASS at tip 22075e9: mark v1.6.0 scene v1.6.1 stages=7 console habitat aligned.

User Story: As a maintainer I need numeric cross-check of geometry motion garden vs docs.
Expected Behaviour: scripts/sim-grid-habitat.py (sibling tool) locks geometry/motion/Monte Carlo/garden/doc↔kit; report scripts/sim-grid-habitat-report.json. Documented in CHANGELOG 1.6.1 + kit/README.
Edge Cases: Docs inventing numbers not in kit.
Notes: Not under kit/ but kit-facing validation dependency.

User Story: As a consumer I need version fields to know which schema I loaded.
Expected Behaviour: mark.json version 1.6.0; scene.json version 1.6.1 (garden.silhouetteHeightPx). CHANGELOG narrates bumps.
Edge Cases: Bumping mark without faces/schema change; silent dual version in hosts.
Notes: Unix: data only; version is metadata on the SoT files.

User Story: As Apps I must load habitat catalogs from kit and expose registerEmotion/Action/Stage overlays — kit does not own console screens.
Expected Behaviour: Consumer contract: console/src/lib/scene.ts imports kit/scene.json; registerFromKit seeds catalogs; registerEmotion/registerAction/registerStage/SceneIntent remain extension surface; LEGACY_INTENT from legacyFaceBridge; PropKind includes repoBranch + growth 0..5.
Edge Cases: Reintroducing STAGE_SEED/EMOTION_SEED/ACTION_SEED dual tables; Casque strings; omitting propKind.
Notes: OUT OF SCOPE for kit ownership: register* UI screens. Documented as DEPENDENCY of kit exports.

User Story: As a port author I use thin adapters that read kit data and emit strings/ANSI/React/presence attrs without forking tables.
Expected Behaviour: adapters/mark from-kit: face→lines/eyes; unknown→idle; mergeMark overlay. ansi tones from mood. react data-face/stage/action/motion/state string ids. presence CSS keys subset of action ids.
Edge Cases: Inventing wink as second face table without mergeMark; parallel motion unions.
Notes: Adapters are Unix filters; kit remains SoT. Recent tip fix: facing wins deep mergeMark.

User Story: As a reader I need root brand docs to narrate kit numbers without inventing parallel id tables.
Expected Behaviour: BRAND/GARDEN/RECIPES/PORTING/SCENERY/STYLEGUIDE/TERMINAL-MOTION/CHANGELOG point at kit/mark.json + kit/scene.json as machine SoT; system-graph tip a31587a keeps recipe seams open.
Edge Cases: Doc claim not in kit; kit id undocumented in graph docs.
Notes: See ID-VOCAB-REVIEW. DEFECT-DOC-001 Fixed (TERMINAL-MOTION — / keep-current). Kit JSON untouched.

User Story: As an adapter author I need the closed set of face.motion values so hosts do not invent wink-timers as kit motions.
Expected Behaviour: Every faces.*.motion is null|pulse|bounce|shake. Motion key always present (may be null). Blink uses motion null (host timer guidance only).
Edge Cases: Inventing sway/hop on faces; treating auto-blink interval as kit constant.
Notes: STYLEGUIDE: auto-blink 6–14s is host guidance only. Face motions ≠ action motions ≠ emotion motions.

User Story: As a scene author I need emotion records with eyes[2] tone hint and optional motion including muted tone.
Expected Behaviour: emotions[].eyes length 2; tone ∈ idle|accent|ok|warn|err|muted; optional motion ∈ pulse|bounce|sway|shake; TERMINAL-MOTION catalog rows match kit eyes/tone/motion.
Edge Cases: Treating muted as mark moodColorsUiOnly key; inventing emotion motion hop; doc eyes drifting from kit.
Notes: Deepens KIT-SCENE-007. muted is scene/host tone only.

User Story: As a presence/CSS host I need closed action.motion pose fx sets so adapters do not invent parallel unions.
Expected Behaviour: actions[].motion ∈ none|bob|pulse|sway|bounce|hop|shake; pose ∈ stand|lean|jump|crouch; fx ∈ none|think|scan|type|wave|spark|search|sleep. TERMINAL-MOTION action table matches kit.
Edge Cases: Inventing fly pose; presence CSS motion id outside actions.
Notes: Deepens KIT-SCENE-008. data-motion ids ⊂ action ids (not action.motion strings).

User Story: As a maintainer I need the historical extraction note without treating console as live SoT.
Expected Behaviour: scene.source is a non-empty string referencing historical console scene.ts path; SCENERY/TERMINAL-MOTION state console is historical and must align to kit.
Edge Cases: Treating console literals as SoT; deleting source without updating narrators.
Notes: Metadata only; kit JSON remains live SoT.

User Story: As a décor renderer I need every stock prop to carry kind x y w h inside the stage strip.
Expected Behaviour: Every stages[].props[] has kind∈propKinds and numeric x y w h; w h > 0; x within [0 stageWidthPx] band (soft). repoBranch still unused in stock.
Edge Cases: Props missing geometry; negative sizes; inventing fields that replace growth schema.
Notes: Complements KIT-SCENE-005/006. Garden overlay props may add growth/label.

User Story: As a maintainer I need GitHub Actions to run check-consumers + kit/qa/run-tests on push/PR.
Expected Behaviour: `.github/workflows/kit-qa.yml` exists; runs node kit/check-consumers.mjs then node kit/qa/run-tests.mjs on Node 22; no app install matrix.
Edge Cases: Deleting workflow; replacing with console-only CI that skips kit SoT.
Notes: Added Phase 4; matrixed Phase 6. Not an Apps UI pipeline.

User Story: As a brand reproducer I need BRAND-RULES.md to narrate clearspace/min-size/mood UI-only without inventing parallel numbers.
Expected Behaviour: BRAND-RULES points at kit/mark.json moodColorsUiOnly; states mascot unnamed; clearspace one block-row; digital min 24px.
Edge Cases: Inventing second clearspace fraction; naming the mascot; Casque as brand voice.
Notes: Was omitted from KIT-DEP-003 narrator list; Linear-minimal — no kit JSON churn.

User Story: As a port author I need linesFor/lockup so desired facing always wins over faces.*.mirrored storage.
Expected Behaviour: adapters/mark from-kit: facing left|right; idle+left uses mirroredIdle hood; loadingLeft+right yields canonicalIdle body; unknown face→idle.
Edge Cases: Mirroring eyes only; treating mirrored:true as output facing.
Notes: PORTING facing-wins. Executable gap closed Phase 6; kit JSON untouched.
